27722.name: PITAKA Galaxy S25 Ultra Edge Case (Sunset)

bullets.title: Be Light, Be Lively
bullets.text: Recreating the first popular item of the Weaving+ series "Sunset Moment", we have woven an immersive blue time from sunset to moonrise.

bullets.title: Premium Weave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong — it's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.

27784.name: PITAKA Iphone 17 Pro Edge Case (Over The Horizon)

bullets.title: Stand Higher Stars Closer
bullets.text: When we reflect on our life's journey, it's nothing but a collection of moments. The Weaving+Moment Series, crafted using premium aramid fiber, captures these enchanting moments on our cases.

bullets.title: Premium Weave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong, t's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: PitaTap™
bullets.text: A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control Button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. Seamlessly integrated, it preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.
